messages:
chris: Seeing a sudden wave of 429s for ORBIT's dedicated pool during the midnight surge. TPS spiked to ~18k, burst credits hit 0, and autoscaler lagged.
anya: which pool and account? any repro steps yet?
chris: pool=dp-orbit-3 account=orbit-inc. repro done in staging, consistent.
chris: admission logs:
```
[2026-03-16T23:01:12Z] admission_controller: admit=false reason=burst_credit_exhausted headroom_tokens=0 tps=17950 pool=dp-orbit-3
[2026-03-16T23:01:13Z] quota_accounting: burst_credits=0 last_refill=2026-03-16T22:00:00Z
```
sam: node-gpu-5 shows 97% GPU utilization, classic noisy-neighbor spike. per-node throughput caps out and autoscaler looks at CPU/mem which stayed below scale_up_threshold so no immediate scale up.
ops-oncall: autoscaler config has cool_down=300s and scale_up_threshold=0.85 for that pool, so it needs sustained signal.
chris: repro steps I used (staging):
```
# simulate token/sec burst
w rk -t4 -c200 -d120 --latency -s scripts/post_payload.lua http://api.staging.redwood/v1/generate
# add header: X-Account: orbit-inc and model=opt-30b
```
anya: billing-bot shows no billing outage, but note: dedicated burst ledger is different from hosted credits.
billing-bot: note: dedicated_burst_ledger for orbit-inc = 0 remaining, last top-up = 2026-03-16T00:00:00Z
infra-bot: admission service policy: prefer_deny_when_headroom_le0 = true. fallback routing disabled for this route by default.
sam: immediate mitigations:
- increase reserve headroom: `pool_config.reserve_headroom_tokens=50000`
- lower scale_up_threshold to 0.65 for dp-orbit-3
- enable `allow_fallback=true` to route to a lower-capacity model variant
ops-oncall: short-term actions taken: bumped scale_up_threshold to 0.7 and pushed a prewarm window for the midnight traffic. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/configs/pull/452
chris: longer term proposals: auto-refill burst ledger on sustained TPS > 10k for > 10m, add per-GPU token cap to detect noisy tenants and fast-evict/balance, and make admission controller more aggressive when headroom decreasing quickly.
anya: can someone run the staging repro with an injected noisy tenant and capture flamegraphs + admission traces?
sam: will run tonight, will post a short runbook and the traces here after the run.
chris: thanks — keeping this thread for the triage notes and follow-ups. :thumbsup:
